verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Kong publishes an llms.txt (HTTP 200) at developer.konghq.com that indexes its docs for Gateway, Konnect, AI Gateway and Mesh. Doc pages are also served as Markdown (.md) variants, such as gateway.md and catalog.md, which suits agent ingestion. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing how agents should use llms.txt or the Markdown docs, and evidence of the depth or completeness of the llms.txt content or an llms-full.txt variant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
